paid_market_gaps.gap: SaaS apps paywall SCIM behind enterprise plans; 43% of 721 apps, only 1.2% include it on base tier
57% of analysed SaaS apps lack SCIM at any price, forcing manual or RPA-based provisioning
Per-connection fees ($60-$125/month) penalise SaaS vendors selling to many small business customers
Some auth platforms reserve SCIM for custom-priced Enterprise tiers

wtp_evidence: SaaS vendors pay public per-connection SCIM fees ($60-$125/month); end customers pay 1.7-5x plan upgrades for SCIM, but free tiers and free open-source options compress developer-side prices.
bundling_note: Auth platforms bundle free SCIM connections (Stytch 5, Frontegg 5, Scalekit 1) and SSOReady is free/MIT, though IdPs like Entra still require each app to implement SCIM.
summary: Developer-side SCIM-as-a-service is crowded and commoditising (WorkOS, Stytch, Scalekit, free SSOReady). The remaining opening is buyer-side: provisioning into apps lacking or paywalling SCIM, already contested by Stitchflow and Aquera.
